text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(—I ran away from Mejiro. But that doesn't 
mean I ran because I hated it.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(It was precisely because I was proud of 
it that I ran away. Because I thought... 
'I'm not worthy,' 'I'm not good enough.')

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Still, even if I turn my back――)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, the Mejiros pushed me forward. 
"If you feel guilty, run away even harder. 
Reach a different kind of strength," they 
said.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(And the answer I found. Together with 
that answer, today, I—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Head-on once more!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's go, Trainer, bestie!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
To hit them with the most ridiculous, most 
unapologetically "me" version of myself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, let's show them today. Just how 
strong a Mejiro Umamusume truly is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"There are so many rivals out there, but 
there's no way I'm gonna lose!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. We have a story that is 
uniquely our own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"—The classic hero's tale. Precisely 
because it is the classic archetype, no 
one can surpass..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! But wouldn't it be boring if that 
was all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"The royal road... It's no fun if only the 
heroes and heroines from the very 
beginning win♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Palmer, you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've got a story I want to show you today 
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A somewhat unusual—tale of Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that said, Mejiro Palmer stands in 
the center of the paddock—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Runaway sprint, runaway sprint☆ Mejiro 
Palmer, good luck today! Hey, did you guys 
know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Look, back in the day, I was seriously 
uncool, and I was so embarrassed about it 
that I ran away from the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If I didn't do that, I wouldn't have been 
able to handle it. But wherever I ran off 
to—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I met my bestie Helios and my Trainer. And 
finally, I was able to start over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Searching for a running style that's truly 
my own from square one, mastering it... 
That's how I managed to reach the stage of 
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I never had any pride to begin with. After 
all, I was a runaway who turned my back on 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Still, right now, I'm proud of who I am! 
After running away from my beloved Mejiro 
family, struggling through it all, and 
finally getting to this point...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Because I've found a strength that puts me 
on equal footing with McQueen and Ryan. 
Even if it's not a very Mejiro-like 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, friendship wasn't the only thing 
found. That friendship granted strength to 
Mejiro Palmer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The power to never give up and stay 
tenacious in the face of hardship. That 
was forged through having fun while 
pushing each other to the limit."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I ran away, but not just to flee! I dashed 
out and searched on and on the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A strength I never could've found if I 
stayed in the Mejiro family! The true 
merits of who I am, once lost in their 
brilliant glare!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"My Trainer and my bestie taught me that. 
That's why I—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've made it here!! To face Mejiro 
head-on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Back then, nobody even looked at me. I 
wasn't even worth glancing at. But 
now—!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Look at meeee!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Even as a Mejiro dropout, even after 
shamefully running away, I've grown truly 
strong and made it back here—look at me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro renegade! A renegade, but still 
a Mejiro! Look at the Mejiro who walked a 
path nobody else could!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There's room for all kinds of stories! You 
know! Like the ones that start out with an 
underdog nobody paid attention to!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A story where weakness turns into 
strength! That is what happens today—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I am! Right here! The Mejiro who's gonna 
hype everyone uuup!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Granted, that might not have been the 
Mejiro everyone had always looked up to. 
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A prestigious family of the Umamusume 
world. It was unmistakably a fragment of 
light that spilled over from that colossal 
sun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen... Today, Palmer is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a Mejiro that transcends anything 
anyone could have ever imagined or 
pictured...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Way to go, bestie☆ So, like, 
basically..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ain't I totally fine on my own? Especially 
when I can hype things up and vibe like 
this♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you think so? Well, guess it's 
thanks to Helios that I can speak my mind 
like this now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, bestie. Let's do this together 
till the end today too♪ When we win, we 
win together, facts!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha, roger♪ No matter what happens, our 
vibes are as one☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's certainly a tough distance for 
Daitaku Helios. Even so, the dream shared 
by the two of them never wavers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bolstered by confidence and unbreakable 
bonds, Mejiro Palmer now stands at the 
gate as the ultimate party people.
